name: kettlebell single arm clean
description: Pulling a kettlebell from the floor to the shoulder with one arm. It trains explosive hip power and coordination.
instructions: Stand over a kettlebell and hinge to grip it with one hand.
Swing it back slightly between your legs.
Drive your hips forward and pull the bell up close to your body.
Rotate your hand around so it lands softly in the rack position.
Lower it back down under control, repeat, then switch arms.
